symbols.name: recordAccessLogView
symbols.sig: export async function recordAccessLogView( db: AccessLogDb, actor: Actor, summary: { filters: Record<string, unknown>; total: number },): Promise<void>
doc: The log of who saw private contact data is itself private, so LOOKING at it is recorded (action "view": who, when, with which filters and how many lines were returned; never the lines themselves). I write one row per distinct look: the same person with the same filters within two minutes (paging back and forth, a refresh) does not write another row, so the history stays readable. The authority is decided again here under the tool's lock.
